thread:
tara: quick heads-up: onboarding sample app produced duplicate customer completions after a 429 during token rotation. repro: generate -> 429 -> sdk refresh token -> immediate retry -> two webhook posts.
sam: can you paste a minimal log snippet? curious if SDK re-sent or server replayed.
tara: log: `OUTGOING POST /v1/generate bodyId=xyz123` -> `RESPONSE 429 {"error":"rate_limited"}` -> sdk: `auth.refresh()` -> `OUTGOING POST /v1/generate bodyId=xyz123` -> `RESPONSE 200 {"id":"gen_abc"}`. webhook received gen_abc and gen_def ~180ms apart.
kevin: so server accepted both. Did sampleapp include any idempotency key for generate calls?
tara: no, only for payments endpoints. We assumed safe-replay heuristics would be enough.
sam: that's risky — generation endpoints might trigger side-effects (webhooks). Options: (A) update sampleapp to attach a request-level Idempotency-Key, (B) change SDK to avoid immediate retry after auth refresh, adding jitter/backoff, (C) add ephemeral client-side dedupe cache for short windows.
kevin: prefer (A) as recommended practice. For SDK defaults: we should wait 50-300ms with random jitter before auto-retry post-refresh to reduce double-accepts.
tara: agreed. Also we saw both attempts had different result IDs; server doesn't dedupe by body.
sam: file SDK issue to: 1) add configurable jitter ms for post-refresh retry (default 100±75ms), 2) emit diagnostic event `retry_after_auth_refresh` with original request hash, 3) opt-in transient dedupe cache behind feature flag.
kevin: make sure this doesn't break streaming resume semantics — streaming callers need immediate resume logic.
tara: good call. sampleapp will only use idempotency-key for non-streaming webhook flows. I'll patch sampleapp repo with idempotency header + tiny repro script.
sam: also add onboarding checklist note: "any endpoint that triggers external side-effects must set Idempotency-Key or rely on server-side dedupe."
devtools-bot: created issue #4762: "sdk: jitter + diagnostics for retries after auth refresh to prevent duplicate accepts"
tara: thanks — PR incoming for sampleapp + repro. can SRE run a quick load test once merged?
kevin: yes, include a script that simulates token expiry then concurrent retries. SRE will validate.
sam: config names: `postAuthRetryJitterMsDefault=100`, `postAuthRetryJitterMsRange=75`, `enableTransientDedupe=false` by default.
tara: noted. i'll link #4762 in the PR and add short docs in onboarding checklist. cheers.
